## Context / Problem
Source comments carry commit SHAs, run/thread IDs, and dated incident narratives that rot: 8 of 18 cited SHAs in the tree are ALREADY unresolvable (Gerrit rebase-on-submit guarantees pre-land SHA death), and run IDs die with retention windows. Policy: source is for current state + concise rationale; the ticket system owns historical detail. The detector is NET-NEW code (the prototype that produced the corpus numbers ran in the planning session and was not committed; its measured results — 0 FPs, 15 violating sites, 47 compliant blocks on the then-current tree — are recorded here as design evidence, and the corpus is re-derived by running the new detector at the implementation worktree's HEAD, which is authoritative; the ticket comment records census drift to 16 sites already).

## Approach
(1) Remediate every detector hit at HEAD (17 pinned above as-of-plan: the original 15 census sites, of which 2 were later found under src/ in the PR-375 bucket, plus 3 post-plan RUN-id sites minus overlap) — each maps to a specific replacement already adjudicated: delete.py:188 drop dead-SHA mechanism sentence; classify.py:310 + test_frozen_census.py:79 cite epic 3006-e198; reconcile.py:588 + tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/state/test_commit_binding_store_failure.py:10 (module docstring's 'cf93b2b7ad failure class') describe the failure class in behavioral terms (story findable via git log -S); test_ci_actionlint_install.py cite bug 4e99-b2ae; test_plan_review_explain.py cite bug c7e3-dd16; test_execution_mode_dispatch.py cite 454a-9266; test_inbound_differ_field_contract.py point at the live CONTRACT block + story a130-2b7c; 7 PR-#375 sites keep 'PR #375 review' and drop raw thread ids (tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/mutate/test_inbound_leaf_bodies.py:63/69/210/310/451 + src/rebar/_engine/rebar_reconciler/typed_dispatch.py:128 + src/rebar/_engine/rebar_reconciler/apply_inbound.py:233); test_at_most_one_invariant.py:199 drop e04e0b289c; 3 RUN-id sites from the post-plan J11/5200 work (tests/external/live_jira_dc/test_dc_mutations.py:163/1638-context + tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/test_inbound_assignee_oracle_discriminates_5200.py:20-context, runs 30721408463/30763838558) get the same treatment — narrative to a ticket, cite the ticket. Line numbers are as-of-plan pins; the re-run detector census at HEAD is the authoritative remediation list and may add/retire sites (same adjudicated replacement rules apply). (2) CI guard from the proven detector: block-level scan (comment blocks + AST docstrings); rot-prone = SHA-like hex >=7 with digits+letters (denylist ed25519/sha256 etc), run/job/thread id >=8 digits after keyword, date+evidence-verb; ACCEPTED when the block cites a ticket/epic/story/bug/rec/ADR id (hex-grouped or word-triple alias) — pointing history at the ticket system is the sanctioned pattern; escape hatch 'context: external' for vendor-pinned refs (changelogs, upstream issue SHAs).

## Scope
- the detector-hit sites listed above (src/ + tests/; authoritative list = detector re-run at HEAD)
- scripts/ or CI lint module implementing the detector + workflow wiring
- short policy note in CONTRIBUTING.md or docs (source=current state, tickets=history)

## Testing
Detector unit tests re-derived at HEAD (prototype-measured shape: ~15-17 pre-fix sites RED, ~47 compliant blocks green — exact counts pinned when the detector lands), the acceptor-arm gotchas ('bug surfaced', 'ticket dirs' must NOT accept; grouped 4x4 ids and word-triple aliases MUST accept), escape hatch honored. Post-remediation tree scans clean.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] All detector-hit sites at HEAD remediated per the mapped replacements; each remediated site that replaces narrative cites a ticket/epic/story/bug id that RESOLVES in the ticket system (spot-check via rebar show).
- [ ] CI guard fails on reintroduced rot-prone refs, passes the current remediated tree with zero suppressions.
- [ ] Escape hatch documented; policy note landed.
- [ ] Detector unit tests cover the FP gotchas measured in the planning prototype ('bug surfaced'/'ticket dirs' NOT accepted; grouped 4x4 ids and word-triple aliases accepted; escape hatch honored).
